assessments.reasoning: The Scala 2.13 modifier definition makes first access the trigger for evaluating a lazy value. An unused definition can remain unevaluated.

challenge.method: Check whether first access guarantees successful, exactly-once initialization.
challenge.results: Recursive access during initialization can loop. If evaluation throws, the value remains uninitialized and a subsequent access retries. The passage supports the trigger with both qualifications.

limitations: Recursive initialization may exhibit looping, and an exception has separate rules. The source does not imply eager initialization at declaration.
Scala 2.13 specification of the lazy modifier. First access can fail and may never occur.
